primary_hypothesis: Predictive memory in the Azores seed system is local-state memory rather than spatial propagation; the unresolved distinction is biological pool state versus receiver/tag observation state.

next_discriminating_evidence_order.evidence: receiver-operability or hardware-change natural experiments at fixed pools
next_discriminating_evidence_order.supports_observation_if: detection-state shifts coincide with receiver/hardware state while pool identity is unchanged

next_discriminating_evidence_order.evidence: independent local hydrology/water-state covariates frozen before outcome comparison
next_discriminating_evidence_order.supports_biology_if: local shared eel activity/detection state tracks hydrology after receiver operability is represented

next_discriminating_evidence_order.evidence: sub-weekly co-activity timing among co-resident eels before documented receiver failure
next_discriminating_evidence_order.supports_biology_if: within-pool synchrony remains beyond receiver-wide observation-state effects

next_discriminating_evidence_order.purpose: prospective confirmation that memory without observed propagation recurs outside the hypothesis-generating stream

primary_next_test.statement: A shared receiver/pool temporal effect remains after individual detection history and known receiver-operability state are represented.
primary_next_test.required_failure_mode: If available data cannot separate pool from receiver because they are perfectly aliased, return unidentifiable and move to an independent receiver/hydrology design.

claim_boundary: The original EOG ~7% gain is not a biological effect size because 9 heldout weeks at a major receiver were affected by documented operability failure.
The pre-failure locality association is robust to that known failure but remains observational.
Do not fit or infer receiver-to-receiver movement in this retained cohort.
A broader movement-compression claim requires independent systems.
